development_findings: The worker regression teardown stopped the dedicated SSH listener; shared lifecycle setup was repeated after starting its backend-dependent listener. Failed setup was not counted as passed security evidence.
A temporary diagnostic frontend was restored before counted checks; captured installed identity is the maintained build.
Native positive peer-authentication mocks bind under the owner UID; merely chowning a root-bound socket is a tested denial.
Resource preparation rejects inherited descriptors rather than closing Rust-owned objects, and minimal environment is set before Rust exec; safe Rust does not mutate global environment.
